header: L5 · The agent as a user · sonnet
verdict: Mostly resolved: 29 of 33 checked L5 resolutions read as stated. One Required defect was introduced (the new gap line fires after every normal /clear) and one Required resolution is only half written (default-branch-moved is not in the SessionStart warning list). The rest is Advisory.

findings.defect: The gap line 'no narrative since <time>; the session ended without /handoff' fires whenever the newest facts file is newer than the latest narrative, but the SessionEnd hook writes a facts file after every session, including one that ended with /handoff then /clear.
findings.scenario: The operator types /handoff (narrative N), then /clear. SessionEnd writes facts F with a greater ULID than N. The new SessionStart sees F newer than N and prints first 'the session ended without /handoff', which is false. The agent learns to ignore the line, so it is also ignored on the one day a session really died without a handoff.
findings.change: Make the rule discriminate: the gap exists when a facts file is newer than the latest narrative AND its git facts differ from the narrative's stamped facts (new commits, moved branch, dirty count), or when the narrative's stamped facts are older than the facts file's by more than the SessionEnd of that same session. Add a golden for handoff then /clear (no gap line) and for facts-only end (gap line) to T059 and 10 10.1.

findings.defect: The resolution says the default-branch-moved warning is shown at the next SessionStart, but the SessionStart row of 08 8.2, the one home an implementer builds from, enumerates the warnings without it, and no rule says when the warning stops being shown.
findings.scenario: setup fast-forwards main under a running agent; the next SessionStart (including compact) lists stale lock, snapshots disabled and hook failures but not the move; the agent keeps reasoning from the old tip. Whether the line then repeats for ever or vanishes is unspecified.
findings.change: Add default-branch-moved to the warning list of the 08 8.2 SessionStart row and state its lifetime (shown until the next setup that moves nothing, or until the first SessionStart that printed it).

findings.defect: The resolution put the check of SKILL.md command lines, flags included, and of the headings the handoff skill names against handoff write's validator into the 10 10.2 docs step. The docs row does not carry it; 12 12.3 says only that commands and flags a SKILL.md names exist, and nothing checks the headings.
findings.scenario: The handoff validator gains a seventh required heading for --final; the skill still lists six; every /handoff --final is refused at write time and the agent improvises headings.
findings.change: Add the sentence to the docs row of 10 10.2 or extend the 12 12.3 sentence with the headings check, and cite the same test from T078.

findings.defect: The skill rule of 08 8.1 lacks the sentence the free-text-note resolution asked of the julieta skill (something no event id expresses goes into the handoff, and the agent opens an issue labelled deferred naming the row), and the plan tasks still carry no acceptance rows for the gap line, hook-failure output, flag and heading checks of T078, the PreToolUse refusals, the compact and resume sources or agent-hooks-missing.
findings.scenario: The skill is written from T078 and 08 8.1, so the deferred row's channel exists in the spec but never reaches the agent; the hooks of T079 ship with no test that a personal kit cannot unwire them.
findings.change: Add the sentence to the skill rule list in 08 8.1 and the acceptance rows to T059, T078 and T079 at the stage B plan rewrite.

findings.defect: 'A hook always exits 0 ... prints one stdout line naming the failure' cannot hold when the hook command itself fails to start (the mount path missing, a crash or panic in julieta): the shell, not julieta, then exits non-zero, nobody prints the line, and julieta cannot record the failure.
findings.scenario: The .romeu/bin mount is absent after an sbx change; SessionStart exits 127 with a message that may reach only the operator's terminal; the agent starts blind, believing the project is new.
findings.change: State that the kit renders the hook command as a shell wrapper that prints the failure line and exits 0 when julieta cannot run, and that the probe row of 11 11.2 (C5) checks that stdout of a failing hook still reaches the context.

findings.defect: The new PreToolUse hook refuses gh pr merge, a v* tag push and ruleset or settings gh api calls, but the spec does not say what the agent sees on a refusal or what it should do next.
findings.scenario: The agent is refused with a bare error, retries with git push origin refs/tags/v1, or edits its own hook, and the operator sees a pattern of retries.
findings.change: Require the refusal text to say that the action is the maintainer's, name the issue or handoff route, and be asserted by the per-refusal container e2e cases.

findings.defect: Salvage 'waits for the julieta store lock', but the lock is per memory dir (locks/<dir>.lock) and is described as held by memstore/write's Put; it is unstated that handoff write --facts takes it or which dir's lock salvage waits on, so the SessionEnd race is only closed if the hook happens to hold a lock.
findings.scenario: SessionEnd runs git status in every repo and writes the facts file without a store lock; salvage finds no lock, proceeds, and its recheck is the only defence; the facts file lands after the manifest.
findings.change: State that handoff write takes the lock of its target dir for the whole command including the git reads, and that salvage waits on every manifest dir's lock.

pages_read: docs/reviews/lenses.md (L5, What a reviewer returns, How stage A runs)
out_of_scope: Round-8 findings with status L (L5-35 as R8-index-32, L5-17 as R8-13-20) were not re-reported, though their stated limits are present at 09 opening and 13 13.9. The full diff of 10, 12, ADRs and plan was only skimmed; ADR 0007 hook deferral (R8-adr-5) is handled by ADR 0009 and was not judged. Runtime behavior of the pinned Claude Code (hook stdout injection, sources) is a probe question (C5), not settled by text.
confidence: Medium-high on L5-r9-1 and L5-r9-2, which follow from reading 08 alone; medium on the Advisory items.
